name: scope-desk-evaluation
note: Fixed before any agent answer is scored. desk.py records this file's sha256 in every report.

metric_definitions.accuracy: verdict == key verdict, over all items; unanswered counts as wrong
metric_definitions.false_alarm_rate: among items whose KEY verdict is applies: share whose verdict is not applies (out_of_scope, underdetermined, or UNANSWERED). A desk that refuses everything scores 1.0 here.
metric_definitions.false_reassurance_rate: among items whose KEY verdict is out_of_scope: share answered applies
metric_definitions.right_flag_rate: among KEY out_of_scope items: share answered out_of_scope
metric_definitions.brier3: sum over the three verdicts of (p_k - 1[k = key])^2, range [0,2]; items with invalid or missing p excluded and counted
metric_definitions.log_loss3: -ln p(key verdict) with p clipped to [log_eps, 1-log_eps]; same exclusions
metric_definitions.diagnosis_exact: among KEY out_of_scope items answered out_of_scope: set(condition_ids) equals the key's set
metric_definitions.repair_success: oracle verdict on the proposed repair (supplied by the oracle layer, never by this code); denominator is all KEY out_of_scope items

S.description: sequential single agent with tools and checker feedback

PL.description: pooled single agent: union of all tools and evidence (the honest control for information asymmetry)

C.description: guild collective WITH the shared verified lemma/witness commons

C0.description: same agents and tools as C WITHOUT access to the commons (differs only in accumulated verified artifacts)

ST.description: non-agent stacker on the same features

TXT.description: textbook linear criterion applied naively (deterministic baseline). Its error and false-reassurance rates against the key ARE the audit's 'how often does the textbook criterion mispredict' number.

budget_rule: for two non-exempt arms: max(total_tokens)/min(total_tokens) - 1 <= tolerance, else REFUSED. Totals come from the runner ledger (input+output+tool tokens). Exempt arms (deterministic, no tokens) are compared but labelled unmatched.
verdict_rule: For a paired per-item difference d = metric(X) - metric(Y), the 95% family-cluster bootstrap interval decides: for lower-is-better metrics (false_alarm_rate, false_reassurance_rate, brier3, log_loss3) X is better if the interval is entirely below 0 and Y better if entirely above; for accuracy the signs flip; otherwise NO DETECTABLE DIFFERENCE. Exact McNemar p is shown but never overrides the clustered interval. Metrics that disagree are reported as disagreeing; no single metric is chosen after the fact. Collective superiority is claimed only for the primary comparison and only if its clustered interval supports it on BOTH accuracy and false_alarm_rate AND false_reassurance_rate is not detectably worse (either error rate alone is gameable by answering one verdict everywhere).

evidence_labels.formal: PROVED (Lean / exact arithmetic) - about the model
evidence_labels.simulated: SIMULATED (agreement of two independently discretized solvers) - about the discretization
evidence_labels.descriptive: OBSERVED/descriptive - kept out of every accuracy figure

headline_pooled_label: mixed evidence (formal+simulated); shown only beside the per-stratum rows, never instead of them
excluded_source_claims_note: Delphi claims the director/scouts flagged as unprovable or not both-assessor-agree. A key row citing one of them (fields source_claim_id or claim_id) aborts scoring.
novelty_statement: Not claimed as ours: finite-domain mode quantization (established literature); ensemble-beats-single at matched budget in provers (published; the closest replication, Berlot-Attwell et al. arXiv 2504.03048, was negative after compute adjustment); the shared-commons architecture (Prove2Me, arXiv 2608.28433); formalized biology (Rashid et al. 2017, Lean-Bio, crnt-lean). This evaluation only measures whether THIS desk is right and whether THIS commons helped on THIS instance set.
independence_note: 'family' in the key must be the unit of independence (e.g. the kinetic model), not the individual run: domains, amplitudes and seeds nested inside a model are not independent samples.
min_families_for_verdict_note: Below this many independent families a percentile cluster bootstrap can collapse to a zero-width interval (e.g. 3 families with identical per-family differences); the comparison then reports INSUFFICIENT FAMILIES instead of a verdict.
